description: This Java class 'PatientEditor' is a property editor for serializing and deserializing 'Patient' objects for use within the OpenMRS framework, enabling conversion between Patient objects and string representations such as IDs or UUIDs in web forms and other data transfer mediums.

classes.name: PatientEditor
classes.description: A property editor class for handling Patient objects, extending OpenmrsPropertyEditor to provide methods for retrieving Patient instances by ID or UUID.

methods.name: getObjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient object from the database using an integer ID via the patient service.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves a Patient object using its UUID string via the patient service.
